nodes.label: Dual-Mode 404 / Game Landing Mechanism
nodes.rationale: A single page serves two faces: missing URLs show the 404 error face, while direct visits to /404.html or ?mode=landing display the KK Cube Run game landing. Inline script in head prevents visual flashing.

nodes.label: Contact Form Missing Backend Submission Issue
nodes.norm_label: contact form missing backend submission issue
nodes.rationale: Contact form previously only displayed success UI without transmitting data. Resolved by wiring form submission to open a prefilled Gmail compose window fallback.

nodes.label: Google Fonts CDN FOUT & display=swap Dependency
nodes.norm_label: google fonts cdn fout & display=swap dependency
nodes.rationale: Web fonts loaded from Google Fonts CDN without display=swap could cause Flash of Unstyled Text or invisible text during loading.

nodes.label: Mobile Menu Overlay Blocking Hamburger Toggle Button
nodes.norm_label: mobile menu overlay blocking hamburger toggle button
nodes.rationale: When mobile menu was opened, its overlay blocked clicks on the hamburger button, preventing users from toggling it closed from the same control.

nodes.label: Playwright 102-Test Verification Suite
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive automated testing across navigation, theme toggle, mobile menu, typing effect, contact form, project gallery, scroll effects, content, accessibility, and responsive viewports.

nodes.label: Missing Skip-to-Content Navigation Link
nodes.rationale: Keyboard and screen reader users had to tab through all navigation links before reaching main page content.

nodes.label: Theme Toggle aria-pressed Tri-State Semantics Issue
nodes.norm_label: theme toggle aria-pressed tri-state semantics issue
nodes.rationale: aria-pressed is intended for binary states, whereas the site supports three themes (dark, light, sunset); aria-label provides more accurate semantics.

nodes.label: Mobile Viewport Navigation Click Timeout Failure
nodes.norm_label: mobile viewport navigation click timeout failure
nodes.rationale: page.click('.nav-links a[href="#about"]') timed out after 10000ms because desktop navbar is hidden by responsive CSS media queries on mobile viewport, requiring interaction with .mobile-menu instead.

nodes.label: Pinned Projects Track (#projects)
nodes.rationale: Uses a sticky horizontal scroll track on desktop (>=861px) to showcase flagship projects sequentially, gracefully stacking vertically on mobile screens.

nodes.label: Conventional Commit & Upstream Push Workflow
nodes.rationale: Ensures standard commit message structure (feat, fix, refactor, chore) and pushes upstream with sandbox bypass if network access is restricted.

nodes.label: Pre-Push Verification & Health Checks
nodes.rationale: Verifies that linting, build, and knowledge graph sync succeed before staging and committing to avoid pushing broken state to remote.

nodes.label: /graphify Trigger & Skill Delegation
nodes.rationale: Directs assistant to trigger installed graphify skill when user types /graphify before doing anything else.

nodes.label: OpenCode Git Staging & Push Command Workflow
nodes.norm_label: opencode git staging & push command workflow
nodes.rationale: Stages working tree changes with git add -A, generates conventional commit message, and pushes upstream with git push.
